## Key Figures for 2013

- **Professional Fees**: $199 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total Reorganization Items, Net**: $2,640 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Aircraft and Facility Financing Renegotiations and Rejections**: $320 million (Source: documents/report.md)

## Calculation

To determine the percentage of total 2013 reorganization items that consisted of professional fees:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Professional Fees}}{\text{Total Reorganization Items, Net}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{199}{2640} \right) \times 100 \approx 7.54\% \]

**Conclusion**: Approximately 7.54% of total 2013 reorganization items consisted of professional fees.
